note: Phoenix incident/lesson registry. Every lesson: evidence + regression test. Status: validated (failure observed + test green) | seeded (mission-required lesson, test green, failure evidence from operator history).

sources.release-incident-history: docs/release-incident-history.md (18 enforced invariants, evidence per item)

lessons.title: llm/stream AsyncIterable contract
lessons.evidence: .phoenix-harness/reports/06-harness-v2-final.md (canary failure 'yield* not async iterable', root cause async listener)
lessons.rule: llm/stream listeners must return AsyncIterable directly, never a Promise; next() called once, synchronously, inside the generator

lessons.title: Tool schema object-root validation
lessons.rule: Every tool parameter map MUST be compiled to an object-root JSON Schema before registration; preflight the wire shape

lessons.title: PowerShell quoting failures
lessons.evidence: V2 telemetry corpus: 467 pwsh calls in main build session; V2 lesson carried forward
lessons.test: tests/native-tools.test.mjs (no shell string interpolation: all native tools use execFile args arrays, never string templates)
lessons.rule: Native tools spawn processes with argument arrays only; model never writes shell quoting

lessons.title: Docker entrypoint mismatch
lessons.test: tests/release-graph.test.mjs (release graph requires hard-gate node before activation)
lessons.rule: Container entrypoints and extracted assets use explicit interpreters; post-install hard gate verifies the running image identity

lessons.title: Raw-tip vs finalized-tip windowing
lessons.test: tests/governor.test.mjs (stale-state class policy: chain evidence expires at 15 min)
lessons.rule: Decision state must be validated against finalized tips; never decide on raw-tip window without finality evidence

lessons.title: Sudo env reset
lessons.evidence: docs/release-incident-history.md item 3 (environment reloaded after mode changes; stale SHADOW shell values)
lessons.test: tests/native-tools.test.mjs (remote tool never relies on inherited env across sudo; env captured per command)
lessons.rule: After privilege/mode changes, environment must be re-established explicitly; stale shell values never select branches

lessons.title: FAILED_PRE_MUTATION retry identity
lessons.rule: A failed pre-mutation check records identity and leaves state intact; retry must re-validate from scratch, never blind

lessons.title: PACKAGE_ALREADY_EXISTS recovery
lessons.test: tests/ctl.test.mjs (install idempotent: re-install over existing preset succeeds, manifest refreshed)
lessons.rule: Package/artifact already-exists states are idempotent-recoverable, not errors; identity check decides

lessons.title: Reused-branch CI failure
lessons.evidence: docs/release-controller-architecture.md item 15 + release provenance (exact-head CI per PR)
lessons.test: tests/release-graph.test.mjs (pr-ci node requires exact head; stale head fails)
lessons.rule: CI runs are bound to exact heads; a reused branch never borrows another head's CI evidence

lessons.title: No-op goal rounds
lessons.evidence: Phase 0 corpus: 69 job_output polling rounds (5.9% of requests, 1M billed-eq); harness seam: agent/pre-step {kind:'reject'} ends a turn blocked with zero model call
lessons.test: tests/governor.test.mjs (bookkeeping-only rounds during active wait or after budget breach are rejected)
lessons.rule: Rounds that change nothing are stopped by the governor; waits suspend the model inside native tools and wake on state change
